messages:
leah: FWIW i landed a draft UI flow for a 'notify preset migration assistant' — goal is to help tenants consolidate per-route notify defaults into SLO-level presets without accidentally increasing fanout. sharing assumptions + API sketch.
ben: nice. what's the high level flow?
leah: 1) discover: find routes with per-route notify defaults. 2) create candidate preset (auto-suggest channels & severity). 3) estimate impact (projected monthly notify units + sample routes). 4) dry-run apply to sample routes (no side-effects) 5) staged rollout (traffic% or route% with stable hashing) 6) finalize + audit.
tim: for step 3, prefer traffic-weighted estimates (7d rolling avg) so preview matches production. route-count % can be an option for quick checks.
ben: agree. can you paste the API endpoints you're proposing?
leah: sure: POST /api/v1/tenants/:t/notify-presets/candidates -> returns candidate preset based on routes. POST /api/v1/tenants/:t/notify-presets/:p/estimate -> { projected_units, sample_routes, traffic_pct } POST /api/v1/tenants/:t/notify-presets/:p/dry-run -> { simulated_fanout, mismatch_warnings } POST /api/v1/tenants/:t/notify-presets/:p/apply -> accepts rollout_policy.
notify-bot: telemetry service: added endpoint /telemetry/estimate_notify_fanout?tenant=...&preset_id=... uses last_7d ingress per route and channel multipliers. returns projected_units:int, sample_routes:[id,id,id], traffic_pct:float.
olivia: UX asks: (a) show a clear badge when projected_units > tenant_commit; (b) let users preview the actual sample payload (json) for one example route; (c) hide heavy estimates behind "run estimate" button so console stays snappy.
ben: quota model: how do we reflect reserved capacity vs pay-as-you-go? we should show both: projected units, projected bill (if over reserve). also add an "enforce_quota" toggle during apply.
tim: internal question: store presets as separate resource or inline on SLO? separate resource wins for versioning and audit. also makes it easier to reference a template from multiple SLOs.
leah: that's my take too. plan: resource notify_preset { id, tenant_id, versions[], owner, default_sampling } and SLO keeps notify_preset_ref.
notify-bot: dry-run returned for candidate 42: projected_units=312, sample_routes=[r-103,r-241,r-77,r-900,r-501], simulated_fanout_peak=28/sec. note: one route had PD+email duplicates -> mismatch_warning: 'duplicate_channels'.
olivia: migration safety: UI should never auto-apply. instead show "suggested presets" with a checklist: channels, quiet-windows, overrides on routes that will keep custom per-route settings. include a dry-run 'apply to sample' button.
ben: rollout policy idea: allow { type: "stable-hash", percent: 5, seed: "epoch-2026-03" } so selection is stable and deterministic. also allow { type: "traffic-percent" } which uses telemetry to pick highest traffic first or random weighted.
tim: need telemetry event shapes: notify.preset.created, notify.preset.estimate, notify.preset.dry_run, notify.preset.apply with fields: preset_id, routes_count, projected_units, actual_units_sample, applied_by, rollout_policy. that will help SA and audits.
leah: good call. i'll add event contract in PR. also adding a periodic job that compares projected_units vs actual over first 72 hours and opens a ticket if >25% delta.
olivia: edgecase: if tenant has many webhooks that dedupe downstream and our heuristics overcount, we should provide a manual multiplier override in the preset UI ("per-webhook multiplier") and a note that changes affect billing.
notify-bot: quick check: candidate preset 42 estimate crosses tenant_commit=200 threshold. recommend showing a "request burst" CTA that files a support ticket if user proceeds.
leah: migration plan: auto-generate candidate presets but leave them unapproved. owners get a console card that shows candidates and a one-click preview/dry-run per candidate. only after explicit approve do we apply.
ben: one more API ask: include sample_window parameter for estimates (7d vs 30d) and allow ignoring historical zero-traffic routes during dry-run sampling.
tim: security/compliance: for tenants flagged as "restricted", require 2 approvers to apply preset. add approver_flow metadata on preset version.
leah: wrapping up: i'll update the RFC with API shapes, telemetry events, and UI mockups. PR will include migration assistant that only writes candidates. pinging on PR when ready.
